name: Descript
tagline: Descript is an audio and video editor that turns recordings into editable text documents: you edit the media by editing the words. Its AI features include Overdub (voice cloning for corrections), Studio Sound (one-click noise removal), and automatic filler-word removal. Podcasters, YouTubers, and online course creators use it to slash post-production time.
